start: build the app into dist/ when its sources are newer, serve it over the pods in pods/, then open the address it prints; stop it with Ctrl+C
dev: serve the app from its sources, the pages redrawn whenever a file is saved
browser: build the app to run in a browser alone into dist-browser/, the pods kept in the browser and copied from the kits' samples, and serve it
build: build the app's pages into dist/
test: run the app's own tests, in test/, on Vitest; they take seconds
test:e2e: run the browser test, in e2e/, on Playwright; needs Chromium: npx playwright install chromium
reset: remove every pod and load Alex's, Priya's, Martin's and Tamsin's again, as when the app was made
pod:load: load a kit's pod: alex-rivera, priya-natarajan, martin-okafor or tamsin-vale
pod:reset: remove one pod and all it holds
kit:export: copy one of a kit's downloads into this folder, as its person saved it
patient:add: check a patient's file, compiling its shorthand, and add it to people/ as their record at that hospital
ask: print a question's rows, as pod/My active allergies
console: open Node's prompt with the pod as `pod`
